{"status": "ok", "stdout": "    def __rich_console__(
        self, console: Console, options: ConsoleOptions
    ) -> RenderResult:
        table = Table(box=box.SIMPLE_HEAVY)

        assert self.header is not None
        assert self.header.row is not None
        for column in self.header.row.cells:
            table.add_column(column.content)

        assert self.body is not None
        for row in self.body.rows:
            row_content = [element.content for element in row.cells]
            table.add_row(*row_content)

        yield table

steps.message:
FILE: rich/markdown.py
LINES: 260-260
FUNCTION: TableElement.__rich_console__
ROOT_CAUSE: The `TableElement.__rich_console__` method calls `table.add_column(column.content)`, but it ignores the `justify` attribute of the `TableDataElement` (the `column` object). This causes markdown table alignment specifications (left, center, right) to be ignored, defaulting to the `Table.add_column` default of "left".
PROPOSED_CHANGE: Change `table.add_column(column.content)` to `table.add_column(column.content, justify=column.justify)`.
OTHER_LOCATIONS: none
TEST_FILE: tests/test_markdown.py
CONFIDENCE: high
